propositions: Retire the phantom SYNC-dependent checks (orphaned, duplicates, stale) from bridge_fsck structured output, human report, and all downstream consumers
Implement unknown_event_types detection using a two-stage offline Git-grep scan against refs/heads/tickets without requiring a checkout
Add store_integrity as an offline binding audit that verifies forward/reverse index consistency and reports six specific types of binding mismatches
Define Git failure semantics such that grep exit 1 is clean, but missing Git executable, missing ref, malformed output, or grep exit >=2 raise RebarError with returncode=2
Preserve informational exit semantics where unknown_event_types does not gate exit status, but store_integrity findings cause exit 1
Maintain backwards compatibility of rebar bridge-fsck CLI command and keep BRIDGE_ALERT emitter, reducer, and bridge-status entrypoint unchanged
